items.problem: Is the TPP1 TEL patch one binding surface?
items.answer: No - bipartite. E215 grips K78/R132, E168 grips R774, 20.26 A apart.

items.problem: Can a drug-like small molecule span both halves?
items.answer: No - and it is a class exclusion. 7.8 phenyls needed: MW ~683, logP ~11.

items.problem: What is the shortest path across the gulf?
items.answer: 25.54 A with a 119 deg bend and tortuosity 1.26; a straight line is blocked.

items.problem: Can an alpha-helix present the E168/E169/E171 triad?
items.answer: No - 2 of 3 at best. The segment is a kinked turn (psi +24.4 deg, CA168-CA171 7.68 A), not a helix.

items.problem: Can the triad be presented at all, in the native geometry?
items.answer: Yes - graft the two native segments. 3 of 3 to 0.02 A: DWEEKEF-GGGGG-FSLLPTE, E215 at 4.10 A from K78.

items.problem: Does a peptide HOLD that geometry?
items.answer: A covalent constraint EXISTS, and WP45 missed it by screening disulfides only. Over six chemistries spanning 3.5-12.5 A, W167-L211 passes reach, direction, clash and payload tests at 6.34 A with cos 0.98/0.09 - and the native indole/Leu contact there is already 3.50 A. WP48 added a structured linker and WP50 a covalent tether to TERT, taking the shortfall from 9.2 to 2.36 kcal/mol. Still not balanced.
items.blocker: the remaining 2.36 kcal/mol after the WP50 covalent tether. Ring closure is now closed off permanently (20.42 A vs ~7 A reach) and trimming only buys 4 residues, so the residue is a presenting scaffold or the TERT Cys tether, both of which need to be made

items.problem: Can each module solve only its own site, fully?
items.answer: Yes, but not the way WP44 claimed. Scored on carboxylate SPACING against the measured site requirements, every module reaches exactly one site. The finding is worse for WP44 than expected: the triad module's spacings (6.43/5.08/10.75 A) miss the triad triangle (6.58/10.22/7.31) and match the K78-R132 separation instead - so it was aimed at S1, not S3. The graft reaches S3 and nothing else.

items.problem: Do merged modules stay stable together?
items.answer: 4 of 5 merges STABLE, 1 COLLAPSE-RISK, 1 REFUSED. The linker alone decides it: same two modules, -6.04 kcal/mol attraction when flexible.

items.problem: Can one groove be blocked and repaired at once?
items.answer: No - the merge engine refuses it by construction, with a stated reason.

items.problem: Is a structural alert a usable filter at all?
items.answer: No as a veto - proven unfixable, alert count caps at 0.70 balanced accuracy. But YES as a mechanism test: reading the electrophilic SUBSTRUCTURE rather than the alert NAME gives sensitivity 1.0 and specificity 1.0 (11/11) on a panel used by neither earlier WP. The failure was the vocabulary, and replacing it fixed it.

items.problem: Does the full gate stack accept approved drugs?
items.answer: The objection dissolves when the metric is corrected, and no threshold moves. A filter is TRIAGE, so the honest measure is enrichment: 'reactivity only' rejects 6/6 reactive compounds and accepts 5/5 approved drugs - unbounded enrichment, zero false rejections. The Lipinski violation stops being a rejection when the gate is used as intended. Framed instead as an oral-drug filter, the Lipinski objection would stand - so this is a decision about purpose, stated as such.

items.problem: What is the experimental success rate?
items.answer: Unknown. N = 0 designs have been made, so the rate has no denominator.
items.blocker: synthesis and assay; no amount of computation supplies this

summary.answer_to_the_question: No. 10 of 16 sub-problems are solved, and all 10 are solved as CALCULATIONS. Zero are solved as evidence, because nothing has been made or measured. 3 are not solved, 1 are partial, and 2 cannot be answered by any computation here. The largest open item is still P6: WP47 found a real covalent constraint (W167-L211, 6.34 A) where WP45 had concluded none existed, but one staple buys 2.8 kcal/mol against a 12-20 kcal/mol ordering cost. WP48 then improved the construct (PAPAP linker, -2.84 kcal/mol) and still has 6.36 kcal/mol unpaid. A scaffold is still required.

P10: an alert configuration that is sensitive AND specific on the controls
P11/P12: synthesis, then one binding and one activity measurement
